# Prospectus shared account controls

`prospectus-accounts-client-0.1.1.tgz` was supplied by the Prospectus account owner
from `packages/accounts-client`, checkpoint
`cfc7b0a941822010e4a0352ed15ab3c5cce8021a`.

SHA256: `2cba5bac9de91df9d8e715f32b534fbb828bdafca8faf421088bafc83209fba9`.

The console imports the React selector and shared account types. It does not
import the server entry or install its optional AWS peers. The package accepts
React 18.3.1 and React 19; this console uses React 19.2.8.

This archive pins a local integration review artifact. It has not been published
to a package registry. Public source publication remains separately reviewed.
